views.front: The seat now has a continuous thin perimeter seam rather than exposed broken ends.
views.rear: Back mounts and cantilever runners retain their original connections while the seam follows the rear seat edge.
views.detail: The full front seam stays seated on the existing lofted cushion, with small cloth-following irregularity instead of floating wire.
views.underside: The closed seat pan and supported runner structure remain intact.
views.clay: The piping follows the upholstered form in clay without altering the chair silhouette.
